story_intro: A devoted husband and father, a man of faith, and a builder by passion. Emmanuel will be remembered for the values he upheld, the bonds he nurtured and the enduring memories he created.

chapters.title: Early Life and Family Background
chapters.body:
Late Mazi Emmanuel Uvere Okoro was born on 15 March 1967 to Late Mazi Emmanuel Uvere Okoro Snr. of Ndi Owu Compound, Ibom Village, Arochukwu, and Mrs Rose Odochi Okoro (née Iteogu) of Amaogwugwu in Umuahia South Local Government Area of Abia State.

His father, who had completed his first degree at the University of Nigeria, Nsukka, proceeded to the University of Sheffield for a master’s degree.

During this formative period, Emmanuel was lovingly nurtured by his mother, a teacher. His upbringing instilled in him a lasting respect for education, hard work, discipline, family and Christian values.

chapters.title: Education and Faith
chapters.body:
Emmanuel’s primary education took him through Umuahia, Arochukwu and Enugu. He later attended Methodist Boys’ High School, Uzuakoli, from 1979 to 1984, where he received a solid secondary education and developed a strong interest in further learning. He subsequently studied at the Federal School of Arts and Science, Aba, before gaining admission to the Federal University of Technology, Owerri, in 1987, where he pursued a degree in Microbiology.

While at FUTO, Emmanuel became known for his love for God and his active service in the Nigeria Fellowship of Evangelical Students (NIFES), where he served as Assistant General Secretary (1988/1989) and General Secretary (1989/1990). He contributed to the music ministry as a drummer and bass guitarist, demonstrating both leadership and a willingness to serve God.

chapters.title: Career
chapters.body:
After graduation, Emmanuel pursued private enterprise in Port Harcourt and Lagos. Although he did not pursue a formal university degree in Engineering, his deep passion for engineering, construction, and infrastructure development became a defining part of his professional journey. Driven by curiosity and a strong desire to understand how things are designed, built, and brought to life, he deliberately pursued various professional courses, technical programmes, and short courses in engineering and related fields.

His passion soon moved beyond learning into practical application. Through years of hands-on experience, continuous learning, and engagement with professionals in the industry, he developed considerable expertise in construction, infrastructure development, and project execution. His work encompassed the construction of roads, residential and commercial buildings, industrial facilities, refineries, and other major infrastructure projects.

What distinguished his career was not only his technical interest, but also his ability to turn ideas into practical realities. He worked with and developed partnerships with international companies and professionals, including partners from China and the United States, bringing together local knowledge, international expertise, technology, and resources to execute projects of significant scale.

His career reflects a remarkable journey of passion transformed into profession. What began as a personal love for engineering and construction evolved through self-development, practical experience, strategic partnerships, and an unwavering commitment to excellence into a career in which he contributed to the development of infrastructure and the built environment.

Above all, his professional journey demonstrates that while formal education provides an important foundation, passion, continuous learning, determination, experience, and the courage to pursue one’s interests can also open remarkable pathways to professional achievement.

chapters.title: Marriage and Family Life
chapters.body:
While in Port Harcourt, he met Ugochi, the calm and gracious woman who would become his wife, at St Matthew’s Anglican Church Nkpogu. Their relationship blossomed, and they were married in the same church on the 23rd of February 2002.

Their union was blessed with three cherished children: Chikezirim, Goziechukwu, and their youngest daughter Ivuomachukwu. Ugochi built a successful banking career while remaining devoted to her family. Her international postings became a shared family journey, made possible by Emmanuel’s steadfast support and the strength of their home.

chapters.title: Character and Legacy
chapters.body:
Emmanuel was deeply devoted to his family, faith and community. He was a member of St James the Great Anglican Church Lekki where he served God faithfully. He valued his relationships with relatives, friends, business associates and all those whose lives touched his own. He will be remembered for the values he upheld, the bonds he nurtured and the enduring memories he created.

His passing has left a profound void, but the impact of his life will continue to live on in the hearts of those who knew and loved him.

closing_message: Though his earthly journey has ended, Emmanuel Uvere Okoro’s memory will remain evergreen. As his family and friends mourn his departure, they also give thanks to God for the years he spent among them and for the love, lessons and memories he leaves behind. May his gentle soul rest in perfect peace. Amen.
